newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank allows equity swaps.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank allows equity swaps.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it was allowing designated banks to conduct equity swaps, effective immediately.

"In order to provide domestic businesses, institutions and investors more tools to hedge risk and more invesment options, the central bank has decided to allow banks to conduct equity swap business, effective immediately," a bank statement said.
The central bank said the reform would "speed up financial liberalisation and internationalisation" of Taiwan's once tightly controlled banking system.
The bank gave no immediate details of the reform.

Central bank officials reached by telephone said that in general the envisaged equity-swap business would involve sale of contracts giving the holder the right to swap one equity for another at some future date.
